title: Algerian Wrap Filling
description: A flavorful filling made with Algerian spices, perfect for wraps or sandwiches. This recipe combines tender meat with aromatic spices, served in a crispy wrap.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the bouillon over medium-high heat.
Add the yummy beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the Algerian spices and stir to combine.
Continue to cook until the meat is fully cooked and the liquid has evaporated.
Warm the wraps according to package instructions.
Spoon the meat mixture onto the center of each wrap, leaving a small border around the edges.
Optional: Top with your favorite toppings, such as chopped veggies or pickled onions.
